query.statement: SELECT ALARM_CLASS_ID, ALARM_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ALARM_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY ALARM_CLASS_NAME
SELECT ALARM_ID, ALARM_NAME, ALARM_CLASS_ID, SEVERITY, MESSAGE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ALARM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@alarmClassId IS NULL OR ALARM_CLASS_ID = @alarmClassId) ORDER BY ALARM_NAME
SELECT MODEL_ID, MODEL_NAME, TARGET_ENTITY, DESCRIPTION FROM COM_STATE_MODEL WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY MODEL_NAME
SELECT STATE_ID, MODEL_ID, STATE_NAME, STATE_CODE, SORT_ORDER, IS_INITIAL FROM COM_STATE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@modelId IS NULL OR MODEL_ID = @modelId) ORDER BY MODEL_ID, SORT_ORDER
SELECT LABEL_ID, LABEL_NAME, LABEL_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_LABEL WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY LABEL_NAME
SELECT RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, PREFIX, SEQ_LENGTH, CURRENT_SEQ, RESET_CYCLE, DESCRIPTION FROM COM_ID_RULE WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY RULE_NAME
SELECT SERVER_ID, SERVER_NAME, HOST, PORT, SENDER_ADDRESS, USE_SSL, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_MAIL_SERVER WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY SERVER_NAME
SELECT RECIPIENT_ID, PLANT_ID, USER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, MAIL_ADDRESS, MAIL_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_MAIL_RECIPIENT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MAIL_TYPE = 'Mail' ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT RECIPIENT_ID, PLANT_ID, USER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, MAIL_ADDRESS, MAIL_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_MAIL_RECIPIENT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MAIL_TYPE = 'Alarm' ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT SERVICE_ID, SERVICE_NAME, SERVICE_TYPE, STATUS, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_SERVICE WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY SERVICE_NAME

SELECT ACTION_ID, ACTION_NAME, ACTION_TYPE, HOLD_CODE, EMAIL_TITLE, SMS_TITLE, PROCEDURE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ACTION WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@actionType IS NULL OR ACTION_TYPE = @actionType) ORDER BY ACTION_NAME

SELECT ALARM_ACTION_ID, ALARM_ID, ACTION_ID, ACTION_SEQUENCE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM COM_ALARM_ACTION WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@alarmId IS NULL OR ALARM_ID = @alarmId) ORDER BY ALARM_ID, ACTION_SEQUENCE

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 존재 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). MERGE COM_MAIL_SERVER AS t USING (SELECT @serverId AS SERVER_ID) AS s ON t.SERVER_ID = s.SERVER_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SERVER_NAME = @serverName, HOST = @host, PORT = @port, SENDER_ADDRESS = @senderAddress, USE_SSL = @useSsl, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SERVER_ID, SERVER_NAME, HOST, PORT, SENDER_ADDRESS, USE_SSL, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@serverId, @serverName, @host, @port, @senderAddress, @useSsl, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 존재 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). MERGE COM_MAIL_RECIPIENT AS t USING (SELECT @recipientId AS RECIPIENT_ID) AS s ON t.RECIPIENT_ID = s.RECIPIENT_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = @plantId, USER_ID = @userId, EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId, MAIL_ADDRESS = @mailAddress, MAIL_TYPE = @mailType, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (RECIPIENT_ID, PLANT_ID, USER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, MAIL_ADDRESS, MAIL_TYPE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@recipientId, @plantId, @userId, @equipmentId, @mailAddress, @mailType, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);

-- 그리드 표준 편집(upsert) — PK 존재 시 UPDATE(CREATED_*는 최초 등록 정보 보존). MERGE COM_ACTION AS t USING (SELECT @actionId AS ACTION_ID) AS s ON t.ACTION_ID = s.ACTION_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ACTION_NAME = @actionName, ACTION_TYPE = @actionType, DESCRIPTION = @description, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ACTION_ID, ACTION_NAME, ACTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@actionId, @actionName, @actionType, @description, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);
